text.p: Tropical Storm Beth has top winds near 45 mph but is strengthening in the Philippine Sea. It is expected to become a typhoon with top winds 75-85 mph before landfall in the northern Philippines, probably in northeastern Luzon, within 48 hours. Beth will likely produce wind damage, a storm surge along the coast, flooding rain, and possible mudslides as it moves across Luzon. Shipping in the region will also be at risk.

Tropical Depression 12 is currently centered about 490 miles south of Havana, Cuba, with top winds near 35 mph. It is moving northwest about 10 mph and is expected to continue this motion through tonight. Strengthening is expected and the system will likely become a tropical storm during the next several hours. The greatest risk during the next 12-24 hours will be to shipping. Increasing rains in western Cuba may lead to some flooding.
